description: Take one part out of a cart. The part's quote is untouched and can be put back with add_to_cart. Returns the whole cart. HOW A CART WORKS: each part in a cart IS a quote — its material, finish, quantity, rules and its pick (selection) live on that part's quote, and nothing is kept twice. To change a part, call refine_quote on its quote_id and pass cart_item_id: the cart follows the part to the new quote by itself. To pick the option to order for a part, store the pick on its quote (refine_quote selection). The cart_id is the only key to the cart — whoever holds it can read and change it — so give it only to the user it belongs to, and never put it in a link you did not get from the network.

item_id.description: The part to take out — its item_id from the cart
